knowledge:
- key_parameters: perfwhm=Defines the window width percentage of FWHM around the median retention time for matching peaks into pseudospectra ;; cor_eic_th=Correlation threshold for pairwise EIC correlation; peaks with correlation higher than this threshold stay in the group ;; polarity=Specifies ionization mode ("positive" or "negative") to calculate adducts ;; rules=Custom or precalculated rule table for adduct calculation ;; maxcharge=Controls the maximum expected charge of isotopes within one cluster ;; maxiso=Controls the maximum number of expected isotopes within one cluster ;; sample=Specifies which sample(s) to use for correlation analysis in multi-sample workflows (specific index, subset, all, or NA for automatic selection) ;; fc_th=Fold change threshold for automatic preselection of pseudospectra from diffreport
- alternatives: xcms=Used for preprocessing (peak picking, alignment, filling) before CAMERA annotation ;; Rdisop=Mentioned for calculating molecular composition from high-accuracy mass and isotope pattern intensities ;; compoundQuantiles=Used for validating isotope clusters using database statistics (KEGG, ChEBI, etc.)
- when_to_use: Appropriate for LC-MS metabolomics or small molecule profiling datasets where peak lists have been extracted (e.g., via xcms) and need deconvolution into pseudospectra, isotope annotation, and adduct/fragment identification to determine exact masses and molecular formulas.
- pitfalls: Running groupCorr without running groupFWHM first results in very long runtimes ;; For multiple samples, if you want a diffreport later, make sure to run fillPeaks on the xcmsSet before running CAMERA ;; Adduct annotation groups must include at least one ion with quasi set to 1 in the rule table, otherwise the group is excluded.

workflows.name: single_sample_lcms_annotation
workflows.intent: Group peaks and annotate isotopes and adducts for a single LC-MS sample.
workflows.stages: 1. Preprocess raw data with xcms peak picking ;; 2. Initialize CAMERA annotation object ;; 3. Group peaks by retention time ;; 4. Annotate isotopes ;; 5. Verify grouping with peak shape correlation ;; 6. Annotate adducts ;; 7. Export annotated peak list
workflows.code:
library(CAMERA)
file <- system.file('mzML/MM14.mzML', package = "CAMERA")
xs <- xcmsSet(file,method="centWave",ppm=30,peakwidth=c(5,10))
an   <- xsAnnotate(xs)
anF <- groupFWHM(an, perfwhm = 0.6)
anI <- findIsotopes(anF, mzabs = 0.01)
anIC <- groupCorr(anI, cor_eic_th = 0.75)
anFA <- findAdducts(anIC, polarity="positive")
peaklist <- getPeaklist(anFA)
write.csv(peaklist, file='xsannotated.csv')

workflows.name: multi_sample_lcms_diffreport
workflows.intent: Annotate isotopes and adducts across multiple samples and integrate results with an xcms differential report.
input: faahko (pre-existing xcmsSet or raw CDF files)
workflows.stages: 1. Preprocess multiple samples with xcms grouping and peak filling ;; 2. Initialize CAMERA annotation object ;; 3. Group peaks by retention time ;; 4. Verify grouping with peak shape correlation ;; 5. Annotate isotopes ;; 6. Annotate adducts ;; 7. Generate and export combined differential report
workflows.code:
library(CAMERA)
library(faahKO)
filepath <- system.file("cdf", package = "faahKO")
xsg <- group(faahko)
xsg <- fillPeaks(xsg)
xsa <- xsAnnotate(xsg)
xsaF <- groupFWHM(xsa, perfwhm=0.6)
xsaC <- groupCorr(xsaF)
xsaFI <- findIsotopes(xsaC)
xsaFA <- findAdducts(xsaFI, polarity="positive")
write.csv(getPeaklist(xsaFA),file="result_CAMERA.csv")
xsg.fill <- fillPeaks(xsg)
diffreport <- annotateDiffreport(xsg.fill)
write.csv(diffreport, file="diffreport.csv")

workflows.name: isotope_detection_with_validation
workflows.intent: Perform targeted peak picking for isotopes and validate putative isotope clusters using database statistics.
workflows.stages: 1. Perform peak picking targeting isotopes using centWaveWithPredictedIsotopeROIs ;; 2. Initialize CAMERA annotation object ;; 3. Group peaks by retention time ;; 4. Detect and validate isotope clusters using database statistics ;; 5. Extract the annotated peak list
workflows.code:
library("msdata")
library("xcms")
library("CAMERA")
mzmlpath <- file.path(find.package("msdata"), "microtofq")
file <- list.files(path = mzmlpath, pattern = "^.*\\.mzML$",
                   all.files = TRUE, full.names = TRUE,
     recursive = FALSE, ignore.case = FALSE,
     include.dirs = FALSE, no.. = TRUE)[[1]]
xs    <- xcmsSet(
   files=file, method="centWaveWithPredictedIsotopeROIs",
   ppm=10, peakwidth=c(5,12), snthresh=25, prefilter=c(3,200)
)
an   <- xsAnnotate(xs, polarity="positive")
an   <- groupFWHM(an, perfwhm = 1)
an   <- findIsotopesWithValidation(object = an, ppm = 10,
                                   mzabs = 0.01, intval="intb",
       maxcharge = 3)
peakTable <- getPeaklist(an)
